title: India monsoon 2019: rain, wind, green

link.method: Pearson r, monthly means 2018-2020 (36 months): all-India land rain (IMERG Final monthly, observed) vs India land NDVI (MODIS MOD13C2), NDVI lagging by 0 to 3 months; best positive lag reported
link.lag_days_note: lag_steps = lag in months x 30.44 days (monthly resolution, so +/- about 15 days)

gaps: Onset here is a data rule on the all-India land mean (7-day mean rain at or above 5 mm/day for 15 days in a row), not the India Meteorological Department onset over Kerala; the all-India mean rises later than the first rains in the south.
Rain is IMERG Final Run v07: satellite microwave and infrared estimates calibrated to monthly rain gauges; daily values over mountains (Himalaya, Western Ghats) carry larger errors.

Rain map frames are 8-day means at 0.5 deg (46 frames, the last covers 5 days); the colour scale is linear 0 to 40 mm/day with a floor of 1 mm/day, values above 40 are drawn at full colour (99.5th percentile of the frames: 45.0 mm/day).
Wind is MERRA-2 reanalysis (a model) at 850 hPa, about 1.5 km up, daily means of hourly fields, drawn as 7-day means at 1 x 1.25 deg; the lane is the Arabian Sea box 10 to 20 N, 65 to 72.5 E.

NDVI is a monthly MODIS composite: the lane holds each month's value on every day of that month (a step, not interpolated); the map changes once a month. Cells need at least half of their 0.05 deg pixels to be valid land.
India means use 0.5 deg cells whose centre falls inside the Natural Earth 1:50m outline of India (cosine latitude weighted); coastal cells and small islands are partly missed.

The rain to NDVI link uses monthly means 2018 to 2020 (36 months), rain from the IMERG Final monthly product (GPM_3IMERGM v07), the lane and 2019 numbers from the daily product. Both follow the seasonal cycle, so the correlation mostly says that vegetation greens after the rains; it is not a measure of year to year sensitivity. Lag resolution is one month (about 30 days).

GRACE and GRACE-FO water thickness is shown on a 0.5 deg grid but its real resolution is about 300 km (3 deg mascons); it measures total water (soil, ground, surface) change relative to a 2004 to 2009 mean, not rain.
Wind at 850 hPa does not exist where the ground is higher than that level (Tibetan Plateau, high Himalaya): those cells are empty, not filled.
Water map: linear scale -40 to 40 cm (anomaly against the 2004 to 2009 mean), no floor; values beyond are drawn at the end colours. The lane holds each GRACE-FO solution over its own date range.
GRACE / GRACE-FO months without a solution, skipped in the rain to water link: 2018-01, 2018-02, 2018-03, 2018-04, 2018-05, 2018-08, 2018-09 (the GRACE to GRACE-FO gap and early GRACE-FO months).
Water lane: 10 days of 2019 fall between GRACE-FO solution date ranges and stay empty (not bridged).
Link strength: rain to NDVI r 0.858 (strong) at 1 month lag, n 35; rain to GRACE water r 0.868 (strong) at 2 month lag, n 29.

hero_norm.method: min..max of the hero series itself (all-India land mean daily rain, IMERG, 2019)
